structure: One primary law is supplied: a common within-cell Gaussian copula with latent correlation 0.8, implemented through stochastic rank pairing. No pairing crosses sex/age cells. The source determines marginal summaries, not bilateral dependence. Consequently, the pairing-sensitive outputs are conditional scenario estimates, not quantities recovered from this study. Proposed runtime checks, not executed here: verify reproducibility for a fixed seed, exact local permutations, unchanged marginal values, and convergence over larger grids and repeated seeds.
parameter_provenance: Source: Massy-Westropp et al. (2011), supplied Table 1 and measurement-method description; no external retrieval was used.

Source rounded right/left mean and SD, in kg: M50 (45, 8.4)/(43, 8.3); M60 (40, 8.3)/(38, 8.0); F50 (28, 6.3)/(26, 5.7); F60 (24, 5.3)/(23, 5.0). The generator preserves supplied arrays rather than refitting these summaries.
Source: seated Jamar analogue measurements, three trials averaged per anatomical hand; described cell distributions were normal.

Source: no within-cell paired observations or inter-hand correlation were supplied. The reported 89% right-handed fraction does not identify anatomical-side dependence or justify reconstructing handedness-specific distributions.
Design: equal cell weights and equal supplied array lengths come from the requested virtual study, not inferred source recruitment counts.
Assumptions: Gaussian copula, latent correlation 0.8 in every cell, independent innovations across individuals and cells, and no additional handedness or trial-level mixture.
requested_estimands: Mean absolute bilateral difference: average abs(right-left) over all virtual individuals. It depends on the assumed pairing.
Percentage differing by at least 5 kg: 100 times the average of the indicator abs(right-left) >= 5. It depends on the assumed pairing.

Mean of both hands: average (right+left)/2 over all virtual individuals. It is invariant to every permissible pairing. Using the rounded source means and equal weights gives 33.375 kg; the actual arrays determine the exact finite-grid value.

Average within-cell rank correlation: compute Spearman correlation separately in M50, M60, F50 and F60, using average ranks for tied strengths, then average the four correlations equally. Do not substitute a pooled correlation. With continuous normal margins, the population value under this copula is (6/pi)*asin(0.8/2), approximately 0.786; finite-grid realizations need not equal it.
limitations: The marginal evidence cannot identify mean absolute difference, the >=5 kg percentage, or within-cell rank correlations. Other dependence assumptions preserving every supplied marginal value can produce materially different answers.
The selected correlation is neither validated nor uniquely supported. One seed represents Monte Carlo variation conditional on this assumption, not uncertainty about the assumption itself.
Gaussian dependence imposes a homogeneous, symmetric association and does not explicitly represent unilateral impairment, handedness subgroups, or dependence that changes with strength.

Finite marker grids and rank assignment approximate the specified continuous copula; they preserve marginals exactly but do not enforce an exact realized correlation. Tied values can further affect realized rank correlations.
The supplied means and SDs are rounded, and normal marginal grids may include implausible tail values. The generator does not clip or otherwise alter them.

The source excluded upper-limb symptoms or arthritis. Neither its marginals nor this assumed dependence can be presumed applicable to unselected community recruitment, clinical populations, or different measurement protocols.
Equal weighting defines a standardized four-cell population, not necessarily the sex/age distribution of another recruitment setting. Conflicting source analytic counts are not resolved or used.
For a cell with fewer than two observations, or a constant hand array, its rank correlation is undefined even though the permutation generator remains valid.
checks_actually_performed: Analytical arithmetic check: equal-weight cell means of both hands are 44, 39, 27 and 23.5 kg, yielding 33.375 kg overall.
Analytical invariance check: permuting left indices cannot change either marginal distribution or the overall mean of both hands.
Static algorithm review: assigning ranks through left_index[score_order] produces each local integer exactly once; cumulative offsets produce consecutive global row_id values.
No Python execution, simulation-based calibration, empirical fit assessment, or external-source verification was performed.
